full_calendar.source: #137 canonical census/#170 all three frozen request rows
full_calendar.zero_flow: retain NO_BET and Gate-B unavailable rows as zero flow; neither is a loss

integer_allocator.cap_bound_leftover: remove sleeves at native cap and repeat weighted water-fill until no ticket budget or no capacity; retain any unspendable cash
integer_allocator.concurrency: all sleeve tickets for an issue are funded before that issue's outcomes; no payout recycling, deposit, loan, or top-up
integer_allocator.gate_b_requirement: settle each allocated ticket with native per-ticket tax; fail closed if no exact ticket-level settlement bridge exists
integer_allocator.minimum: budget under ¥2 or all native requests zero is NO_BET, zero flow not a loss
integer_allocator.raw_ticket_target: iterative normalized sleeve weight × remaining ticket budget, hard-capped at native requested tickets
integer_allocator.rounding: each water-fill pass floors capped quotas, then gives one residual ticket to largest fractional quota; ties sleeve_id ascending

methodology_contract.M_rule: UPSTREAM_FROZEN_FIXED: FULL=2187, MODEL=512, Q=192. No new M scan or post-outcome M choice.

attribution.covariance: report cross-sleeve concurrent issue covariance and diversification attribution separately from within-sleeve ticket outcomes
attribution.stage4: attribute size/downscale/cash/weight lift against the same-sleeve native-request and equal-weight controls; do not mislabel it as selection, direction, or ticket-construction lift
attribution.upstream: report each inherited Stage-1→3 sleeve path unchanged at native request alongside its actual Stage-4 funded flow

bootstrap.draw: common deterministic issue-resample matrix paired across every portfolio

methodology_contract.membership: all nonempty subsets of the three fixed sleeves (7 portfolios); no Stage 1–3 selection, direction, ticket, or M construction changes

weight_model.PRIOR_ERC: start equal; multiplicative risk-contribution iteration w_i←normalize(w_i×target_RC/RC_i), max 5000 iterations, convergence max|RC-target|<=1e-12
weight_model.constraints: long-only weights, each >=0, sum exactly 1; current issue is never in history
weight_model.covariance: unbiased sample covariance of 52 common active issue returns, then 10% diagonal shrinkage
weight_model.fallback_action: EQUAL_WEIGHT with explicit per-issue fallback reason
weight_model.history: strictly prior chronological full-calendar issues. NO_BET/unavailable stays a zero-flow path row but is absent from active-return samples. Dynamic methods require 52 most-recent common active observations for every participating sleeve.
weight_model.issue_return: pre-tax sleeve net / actual sleeve stake; only actual stake > ¥0 produces an active observation
